"""A listener of ``order.placed``."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, final

from xtr_event_dispatcher import as_event_listener

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from xtr_event_dispatcher import Event

__all__ = ["AuditOrderListener"]


@final
class AuditOrderListener:
    """Reacts to ``order.placed``."""

    @as_event_listener("order.placed")
    async def on_order_placed(self, event: Event) -> None:
        """Handle ``event``."""
        del event  # Replace with what reacting to the event does.
